description.value: Bbong is a Korean-Chinese restaurant located in Hanin Village in Coquitlam, a short walk from Lougheed Town Centre SkyTrain station. It specialises in Korean-inflected Chinese dishes — notably jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), jjajangmyeon (black bean noodles), and kkangpunggi (crispy fried chicken) — a cuisine tradition distinct from both standard Korean and Chinese menus. The restaurant offers both in-person dining and online ordering for pickup or delivery.
